title: Baba Ganoush

items: Sesame Seeds (black and white for garnish)

steps: Slice the eggplants approximately ½” thick, then drizzle olive oil on top and season with salt and pepper.
On a hot grill (recommended) or preheated broiler, sear the eggplant until charred on both sides.
Transfer the slices to a baking tray and finish cooking in an oven at 375°F for approximately 10-20 minutes until the flesh is tender.
While the eggplant is still warm, carefully remove the skin and transfer the flesh to a food processor.
Add garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, tahini, and 1 Tbsp of salt, then pulse for 5-10 seconds until combined into a rough paste.
Transfer to a serving dish, then drizzle with additional olive oil and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
